---
name: Usage report
about: You filled one of these templates for real work
title: "usage: <bundle>"
labels: usage
---

**This is the most valuable issue anyone can open here, and the rarest.**

No template in this library has been filled by anyone but the author. The catalog's own rule gates Tier 2
on "survives one real usage cycle", so by the library's own standard nothing has graduated. One honest
usage report changes that.

**Which bundle, and which variant** (lean or full).

**What you were actually doing.** Enough context to judge whether the template fitted the job.

**What worked.**

**What did not.** A section you skipped and why. A question the ASK block did not ask. A place the guidance
was wrong for your situation. Blunt is better than polite here.

**Did you self-grade against the rubric, and did the score match your own judgement?** If the rubric said
the document was fine and you thought it was not, that is a finding about the rubric.
